prompt: Edit the supplied machine-gun Level 2 game sprite into ONE two-layer runtime atlas image. Canvas aspect ratio exactly 2:1, 1536x768. Two equal square cells side by side, no gutters, no labels: LEFT cell stationary armored base only, remove weapon and complete the chassis underneath it; RIGHT cell only the detached rotating weapon assembly, remove its floor and remove muzzle flashes or fire. Keep the distinctive reference pixel-art design and level 2 armor colors. Both objects individually centered in their square. The base rotation mount and the head rotation pivot must each be at their square's center. Base spans 70% of square width, gun head spans 60% width and 70% height. Point barrels vertically UP. When cells are overlaid at their center they must form one coherent turret. Render on a PERFECTLY FLAT SOLID PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff backing, no checkerboard, no shadows outside objects, no colored reflections from the backing. The game will chroma-key this exact magenta into alpha at texture load. Preserve dark sprite outlines.
